ex.en: Our tablet connects to the wifi.
ex.ko: 우리 태블릿은 와이파이에 연결된다.

easy: In scary stories, a dead body that walks around again.

ex.en: In the Halloween movie, the zombie walked slowly.
ex.ko: 핼러윈 영화에서 좀비가 느릿느릿 걸었다.

easy: A way to measure land, a little smaller than a football field.

ex.en: Grandpa's farm has ten acres of corn.
ex.ko: 할아버지의 농장에는 옥수수밭이 10에이커 있다.

easy: To start to exist.

ex.en: A new game arose at our school this year.
ex.ko: 올해 우리 학교에 새로운 놀이가 생겨났다.

easy: To happen or start to be a problem.

ex.en: A problem arose when the bus broke down.
ex.ko: 버스가 고장 나자 문제가 생겼다.

easy: Having to do with cars and trucks.

ex.en: My uncle works in an automotive shop.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 자동차 정비소에서 일하신다.

easy: Asking people for money or food because you have none.

ex.en: Many people were kind to the man who was begging for food.
ex.ko: 많은 사람들이 음식을 구걸하는 그 남자에게 친절하게 대했다.

easy: When a plant grows flowers.

ex.en: The cherry trees are in full bloom.
ex.ko: 벚나무가 활짝 피었다.

easy: The best, strongest time of a person's young life.

ex.en: Grandma says she was in the bloom of youth at twenty.
ex.ko: 할머니는 스무 살 때가 한창때였다고 말씀하신다.

easy: A person who is dull and makes others feel bored.

ex.en: Nobody wanted to sit with the bore who talked all day.
ex.ko: 아무도 하루 종일 떠드는 따분한 사람 옆에 앉고 싶어 하지 않았다.

easy: To tie things together in a bunch.

ex.en: Dad bundled the old newspapers with string.
ex.ko: 아빠는 오래된 신문을 끈으로 묶으셨다.

easy: A person who makes others laugh by acting silly.

ex.en: Max is the class clown who makes everyone laugh.
ex.ko: 맥스는 모두를 웃게 만드는 반 분위기 메이커이다.

easy: To act silly to make people laugh.

ex.en: Stop clowning around and do your work.
ex.ko: 그만 장난치고 네 할 일을 해라.

easy: Having a high price.

ex.en: A diamond ring is costly.
ex.ko: 다이아몬드 반지는 값비싸다.

easy: Coming from Cuba or having to do with Cuba.

ex.en: We ate Cuban sandwiches at the festival.
ex.ko: 우리는 축제에서 쿠바식 샌드위치를 먹었다.

easy: A person who was born in or lives in Cuba.

ex.en: My new neighbor is a Cuban who loves baseball.
ex.ko: 새 이웃은 야구를 좋아하는 쿠바 사람이다.

easy: The act of moving down.

ex.en: The hikers began their slow descent down the mountain.
ex.ko: 등산객들은 산을 천천히 내려가기 시작했다.
